apps.ui_stack_rationale: 新建工程，采用状态驱动的 SwiftUI；媒体选择、平台相机、播放图层和协议网页通过小范围原生桥接承载。
apps.name_meaning_zh: 用户指定的品牌名 Nina
apps.name_theme_rationale: 用户指定名称，Nina 作为滑板刊物的短刊头。
apps.name_social_rationale: Crew 按真实的板点与练习记录发现同场滑手。
apps.audience: Adult skateboarders building their trick repertoire and returning to familiar skate spots.
apps.product_promise: Turn a line you spotted into a trackable goal and a reason to return to a spot.
apps.main_loop: Browse Lines → save a spot and attach a media reference → log attempts and landings → revisit the spot and see contributing skaters in Crew.
unique_features: Spot Book records obstacle, condition and access notes and connects repeat visits with skaters.
Trick Log records stance, attempt and landing totals, progression and an optional Lines reference.
apps.home_primary_task: Browse a curated line or photo by terrain and pull a reference into practice.
apps.community_content_location: Lines has the editorial photos and clips, their details and comment threads. Crew profile has private submitted work and saved lines.
apps.user_discovery_location: Crew directory and spot contribution lists within Spot Book.
apps.message_location: Crew → Messages with separate Drafts and Activity tabs.
apps.creation_entry: Lines → Post or a profile’s Submissions. Sessions → Add spot or Log tricks.
apps.profile_structure: Crew → Your profile includes skate stance and bio, visits, saved lines, works, relationships, Wallet and Settings.
apps.showcase_media_direction: Locally supplied skate films and photo essays, with travel and style in Off the Board.
apps.showcase_page_composition: Condensed masthead, terrain filters, large editorial cover, horizontal clips strip and still-photo grid.
apps.visual_style: Independent skate zine with printed concrete rubbings, pine ink and a grip-yellow action accent.
apps.asset_direction: Host-native Image 2 wheel mascot, original tab grounds and transparent ink icons.
tab_background_directions: Lines: bowl coping rubbing and deck edge.
Crew: two crossed board shadows at a bench.
apps.seed_data_direction: Editorial media metadata only. Registered profiles and interaction counts come from actual user actions.
apps.architecture_direction: Account-isolated JSON state, Keychain session, URLSession read-only Storage images, single AVPlayer, verified StoreKit ledger.
apps.theme_mapping: Terrain media suggests a spot and a trick reference. Named spot visits surface actual participating profiles.
